title: Be authorised to wholesale medicines and poisons
what: Wholesale scheduled substances or prescribed therapeutic goods only as authorised under the Act (a wholesale licence).

laws.title: Medicines, Poisons and Therapeutic Goods Act 2022 (NSW)

sources.title: Medicines, Poisons and Therapeutic Goods Act 2022 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not wholesale supply, or cause or permit wholesale supply of, scheduled substances or other prescribed therapeutic goods unless— (a) the wholesale supply is authorised under this Act,
